sources.note: Nothing. Kudu and Camo appear only in Table 1 ('Probably extinct', source Shimizu 1982), an endangerment remark and the 'arm, hand' appendix (Kudu mo-ri, Camo ukeri). Sec. 3.1 Phonology describes Boze only (four level tones); says other East Kainji languages have reduced tone systems and that Shimizu (1979, 1982a) transcribes tone in his Northern Jos lists as High/Low or High/Low/Downstep. The word 'stress' does not occur.
